Today's session

Four pillars, one workflow

A

Spatial Types

Location is a type, not just two columns. GEOGRAPHY is spherical and measures in metres. GEOMETRY is planar.

B

The Ecosystem

FEMA claims and county boundaries from the free Marketplace listing. CARTO turns the result into something others can explore.

C

Spatial Functions

Ask “inside,” “near,” and “how far” in the analysis. ST_INTERSECTS, ST_DISTANCE, ST_DWITHIN. All in SQL.

D

AI Across the Workflow

CoCo helps build and explain the query. CoWork answers in plain language. The evidence stays inspectable.
